title: 第二十二章 发小重逢第二十三章 崴脚了
content_zh:
发小久别重逢，话匣子打开了就很难关上了，林昆坐在张大壮的摊位里，何翠花拿出三瓶矿泉水分给林昆、张大壮、章小雅，张大壮小时候就是个话篓子，这一下更是滔滔不绝起来，把小时候那些同学、伙伴的大体情况都跟林昆说了一遍，并且还告诉林昆这个月底有一次同学聚会。
林昆的童年是在乡下度过的，收养他的是一个孤寡老人，老人年轻的时候抗美援朝过，曾是第一司令的警卫员，后来在一次战斗中严重负伤，瞎了一只眼睛瘸了一条腿，林昆小时候打架的那些招式都是他教的。
对于自己的身世，林昆一直都是个迷，老人说是在村口拣到他的，在他入伍的第二年，老人就去世了，当时他跪在漠北的大沙漠里嚎啕大哭，后来一次回家省亲的机会，他回到了家乡，本来想跪在老人的坟前磕个头，可才知道老人连个坟都没有，骨灰直接撒进了村前的那条河里，他跪在那条河边磕了三个头，点了一炷香，然后就再也没回去过。
这一晃就是五年多了……
林昆的家乡离中港市其实不远，七八百里的距离，从张大壮的口中得知，小时候的那些同学伙伴们现在大都在中港市发展，这也是这次聚会能组织起来的先天条件。
许多同学都已经在中港市买房结婚了，其中混的最好的是小学的学习委员黄权，他在沿海的小区买了一套房，100多个平方，总房款快200万了。
提起黄权，林昆的脑海里马上浮现出一个瘦小三角眼的男人形象，黄权身高长的像他妈，脑袋则像他那个在村里当会计的爹，滴溜溜的转的飞快，而且鬼主意多，从小就会溜须拍马，一直是老师跟前的红人，平时总好向老师打个小报告什么的，就因为这个林昆没少揍他……
现在回想起来，往事不堪回首，林昆在心底笑了笑，像黄权这样的人，在现在这个社会混的开很正常，这个社会坑的最多的就是老实人，却成全了黄权那样的人。
说到买房子的那几个同学，张大壮脸上说不出的羡慕，他现在和媳妇还租住在地下室，说到自己的住房，张大壮不好意思的挠了挠头，“昆子，按说我应该请你去家里坐坐，但我那地方的环境实在是太差了，要不这样吧，咱们出去找个地方坐坐，这附近有家馆子不错，咱边喝边聊？”
林昆这才意识到，已经快下午四点了，小楚澄四点半准时放学，他之前跟楚静瑶说好的，每天都必须去接儿子放学，楚静瑶有空的时候他们俩一起，楚静瑶如果没空就他一个人去，这其实也是小楚澄的意愿，小家伙盼了那么久才盼到爸爸，当然想每天上下学爸爸都能接送他。
林昆笑着对张大壮说：“大壮，今天真不行，我得去接孩子放学了。”
一听这话，张大壮顿时惊讶不小，本以为林昆现在当保安，肯定要收入没收入，要住房没住房，就这条件能把上章小雅这样天生丽质的妹子已经算是奇迹了，没想到他把孩子也整出来了，而且都已经上学了！
再看章小雅，白皙漂亮的脸蛋青春气息十足，怎么看最多也就二十岁，这么年轻孩子就上学了，那她岂不是十五六岁就得把孩子生出来了？
张大壮顿时凌乱了，何翠花脸上的表情也是诧异非常，夫妻俩看看林昆，又看看章小雅，张大壮在心里直冲林昆竖大拇指，意思是哥们你太能干了！何翠花则看着章小雅直在心底慨叹，年轻就是好啊，生完孩子了身材恢复的这么好。
“大壮，翠花，我先走了，等改天有时间了，咱们再一起出来坐坐。”林昆起身告别，拍了拍张大壮的肩膀，笑着道：“兄弟，有事打电话。”
“嗯。”张大壮点点头，露出质朴憨厚的笑容，嘴里那少了半截的门牙颇添喜感，恍惚间他仿佛回到了小时候，那时候林昆经常对他说的一句话：“兄弟，谁欺负你了告诉我。”
张大壮一直送林昆到农贸市场的大门口，门外就有停着的出租车，章小雅抱着两盆何翠花送给她的小花先上车，张大壮把林昆拉到一旁小声的说：“昆子，这次同学聚会，周晓雅可能也会来。”
林昆脸上的笑容微微一僵，脑海里马上浮现出一个长发飘飘的女子，她的一颦一笑，她的音容笑貌，至今仍清晰的保留在他的脑海里。
“嗯，我知道了。”林昆笑了一下，转身坐进了出租车。出租车已经开远了，张大壮还站在原地，无奈的摇头的叹了口气，“他还是没忘了她呀。”
张大壮回到了摊位，何翠花手里握着一张百元大钞站在那儿，表情也些不对劲儿，张大壮忙问怎么了，是不是收到假钞了，何翠花摇头，指着林昆刚才坐的位置说：“这是在那张凳子下面发现的。”

“一定是昆子掉的……”张大壮边说，边掏出了电话就要给林昆打过去，号码刚要拨出去，他又把手机放下来了，冲着何翠花道：“算了，这钱肯定是昆子故意留下的，他是看我们不容易，不能白拿了那两盆花。”
何翠花道：“大壮，咱还是把钱还给昆子吧，那两盆花是我送给小雅妹子的，现在这成啥了，再说那两盆花也不值这么多钱啊，你快给昆子去个电话吧。”
张大壮笑着说：“媳妇，真不用，你是不了解昆子，他是把我当兄弟才这样的。”
何翠花看着张大壮，叹了口气道：“好吧，你们男人的世界我不懂，只要你别兄弟如手足，把我当衣服就好了。”
张大壮哈哈笑道：“媳妇，那是绝对不能的！”
何翠花笑着白了他一眼。
这时，摊位的门口突然传来一声轻佻的吆喝：“哟呵，张黑子，这大白天就和你媳妇在这起腻呢，得注意着点哈，周围这么多眼睛看着呢。”
说话的是个满头黄毛的小青年，穿着一件黑色的小背心，脖子上胳膊上纹满了纹身，鼻子和耳朵上扎了好几个铁环，一看就是个市井小混混。
在这黄毛的身后，跟着两个跟他装扮差不多的小青年，一个剃着个板寸，另一个留着一头飘逸的长发，这两人的手里还耍酷拎着两根棒球棒。
张大壮一听到这声音，心里就忍不住的恶心，但脸上还是一副恭谦的表情，冲那黄毛打招呼：“飞哥，今天怎么用空来这转转了，快里边请。”
黄毛表情戏谑的道：“想你媳妇了呗，就过来看看。”说着，还冲何翠花抛了个媚眼。
“你……”张大壮顿时就要发怒，拳头都已经握上了，却被何翠花给拦住了。
黄毛更加肆无忌惮的戏谑起来，“张黑子，瞧你那怂样，怎么，还想跟我动手？”
张大壮咬牙道：“飞哥，你别太过分了。”
黄毛眉毛一挑，脸上的表情翻篇似的一变，顿时破口大骂道：“你个臭不要脸的狗东西，咱俩到底谁特么的过分，你都欠老子两个月的保护费了，今个你特么的要是再不交，老子立马就砸了你这些花花草草！
张大壮愤愤的就要回他，被何翠花向后拽了一把，何翠花站到前面，陪着笑脸道：“飞哥，你别生气，我家大壮就这驴脾气，保护费我们不是不交，实在是最近的生意不太好，手头里一直不宽绰，而且……”
何翠花顿了一下，语气变的谨慎起来，道：“这保护费涨的有点太快了，刚开始二百块钱一个月，现在涨到八百了，我们这是小本生意……”
不让何翠花把话说完，黄毛怒嚷着道：“臭娘们你甭说那些没用的，现在都什么年代了，物价飞奔，还不许老子涨保护费？别人家怎么都能交保护费，就你们家不交，我看你是有心跟老子作对不想在这干了吧！”
何翠花赶紧陪着笑脸道：“飞哥你别误会，我这也就是女人抱怨一下，你别往心里去，保护费我们肯定交，但是你看能不能再宽限两天？”
“不能，今个要么乖乖的交保护费，要么赶紧给老子滚蛋，以后别在这农贸市场混了！”黄毛盛气凌人的道，他身后的两个小弟颠了颠手里的棒球棒。

周围围来了不少看热闹的人，何翠花脸颊红的发烫，张大壮站在何翠花的身后死的心都有了，他堂堂一个老爷们，躲在女人的身后，这算哪门子的事儿，想着他就准备站出来跟黄毛理论，实在不行就干它一架，成天喊这个比自己小的兔崽子哥，还被他欺负着，就跟吃了苍蝇一样恶心！
何翠花像是跟他有心灵感应似的，他刚握紧了拳头，就回过头看了他一眼，低声的道：“你别冲动，这事我来解决，咱们毕竟得靠这买卖生活。”
一听到‘生活’两个字，张大壮顿时就没了脾气，所有的不忿都只能压下去，其实他这个花摊也不是不赚钱，只是他家里有生病常年吃药的父亲，还有要供着读书的妹妹，花摊一个月赚的那点钱，根本不够拆。
何翠花又陪着笑脸喊了一声飞哥，好话说了一大堆，黄毛这才勉强松口，说再给他们一个星期的时间，一个星期后要是还交不出保护费，后果自负。
说话间，黄毛瞥见了何翠花手里攥着的林昆留下的那一百块钱，顿时眼前亮抢了过去，并举起来挥舞着得意的道：“走，哥几个喝酒去！”领着两个小弟走了。
content_en:
After a long separation, it was difficult to close the chatterbox. Lin Kun sat in Zhang Dazhuang's booth. He Cuihua took out three bottles of mineral water and gave them to Lin Kun, Zhang Dazhuang, and Zhang Xiaoya. Zhang Dazhuang had always been a chatterbox when he was a child. Now he started talking nonstop. He told Lin Kun about the general situation of his childhood classmates and partners, and also told Lin Kun that there would be a class reunion at the end of this month.
Lin Kun spent his childhood in the countryside. He was adopted by a lonely old man. When he was young, the old man fought against the United States and aided Korea. He was once a guard of the First Commander. Later, he was seriously injured in a battle and lost one eye and one leg. He taught Lin Kun the moves he used to fight when he was a child.
Lin Kun has always been a mystery about his life experience. The old man said that he picked him at the entrance of the village. The old man passed away the second year after he joined the army. At that time, he knelt in the desert of Mobei and howled. Later, when he had the opportunity to go home to visit his relatives, he returned When he arrived at his hometown, he originally wanted to kneel in front of the old man's grave and kowtow, but then he realized that the old man didn't even have a grave. His ashes were scattered directly into the river in front of the village. He knelt by the river, kowtowed three times, lit a stick of incense, and then never went back.
It’s been more than five years now...
Lin Kun's hometown is actually not far from Zhonggang City, a distance of seven to eight hundred miles. Zhang Dazhuang learned from Zhang Dazhuang that most of his childhood classmates are now developing in Zhonggang City. This is also the innate condition for organizing this gathering.
Many classmates have bought houses and got married in Zhonggang City. The best among them is Huang Quan, the study committee member of the primary school. He bought a house in a coastal community with an area of ​​more than 100 square meters and a total house price of almost 2 million.
Mentioning Huang Quan, Lin Kun's mind immediately conjured up the image of a thin man with triangular eyes. Huang Quan was tall like his mother, and his head was like his father who was an accountant in the village. He was very fast and had lots of ideas. He had always been a popular person in front of the teacher since he was a child. He always made small reports to the teacher, just because Lin Kun beat him often...
Thinking back now, the past was too painful to look back on, and Lin Kun smiled in his heart. It is normal for people like Huang Quan to live happily in today's society. The people in this society that cheat the most are honest people, but it makes people like Huang Quan happy.
Speaking of the classmates who bought the house, Zhang Dazhuang had unspeakable envy on his face. He and his wife are still renting in the basement. When talking about his own house, Zhang Dazhuang scratched his head in embarrassment, "Kunzi, I should invite you to sit at home, but the environment in my place is really bad. How about this? Let's go out and find a place to sit. There is a nice restaurant nearby. Let's talk while drinking?"
Only then did Lin Kun realize that it was almost four o'clock in the afternoon. Little Chu Cheng got out of school on time at 4:30. He had agreed with Chu Jingyao before that he would pick up his son from school every day. When Chu Jingyao was free, they would go together. If Chu Jingyao had no time, he would go alone. This was actually Xiao Chu Cheng's wish. The little guy had been looking forward to his father for so long. Of course, he wanted his father to pick him up and drop him off every day.
Lin Kun smiled and said to Zhang Dazhuang: "Dazhuang, today is really bad. I have to pick up the children from school."
When he heard this, Zhang Dazhuang was immediately surprised. He thought that Lin Kun would have to have income and housing as a security guard. It was a miracle that he could get a naturally beautiful girl like Zhang Xiaoya under these conditions. Unexpectedly, he had also raised his children and they were already in school!
Looking at Zhang Xiaoya again, her fair and beautiful face is full of youthfulness. She looks like she is only twenty years old at most. If a child goes to school at such a young age, wouldn't she have to give birth to her child when she is fifteen or sixteen?
Zhang Dazhuang was immediately confused. The expression on He Cuihua's face was also very surprised. The couple looked at Lin Kun and then at Zhang Xiaoya. Zhang Dazhuang raised his eyebrows at Lin Kun in his heart.Thumbs up, it means buddy, you are so capable! He Cuihua looked at Zhang Xiaoya and sighed in her heart, it is good to be young, her figure has recovered so well after giving birth.
"Dazhuang, Cuihua, I'm leaving first. When we have time another day, let's go out and sit together." Lin Kun stood up to say goodbye, patted Zhang Dazhuang on the shoulder, and said with a smile: "Brother, call if you need something."
"Yes." Zhang Dazhuang nodded, showing a simple and honest smile. The half-missed front teeth in his mouth added to the joy. In a trance, he seemed to have returned to his childhood, when Lin Kun often said to him: "Brother, tell me who bullied you."
Zhang Dazhuang took Lin Kun to the gate of the farmer's market. There was a taxi parked outside the door. Zhang Xiaoya got in the car first holding two pots of He Cuihua flowers given to her. Zhang Dazhuang pulled Lin Kun aside and whispered: "Kunzi, Zhou Xiaoya may also come to this class reunion."
The smile on Lin Kun's face froze slightly, and a woman with long flowing hair immediately appeared in his mind. Her smile, voice, and smile were still clearly retained in his mind.
"Well, I know." Lin Kun smiled, turned around and got into the taxi. The taxi had already driven away, but Zhang Dazhuang still stood there, shaking his head helplessly and sighing, "He still hasn't forgotten her."
Zhang Dazhuang returned to the stall. He Cuihua was standing there holding a hundred-dollar bill in her hand, with a strange expression on her face. Zhang Dazhuang quickly asked what happened, if he had received a counterfeit bill. He Cuihua shook his head, pointed to where Lin Kun was sitting just now and said, "I found this under that stool."
"Kunzi must have dropped it..." Zhang Dazhuang said as he took out his phone and was about to call Lin Kun. Just as he was about to dial the number, he put down the phone again and said to He Cuihua: "Forget it, Kunzi must have left this money on purpose. He saw that it was not easy for us, so he couldn't take those two pots of flowers in vain."
He Cuihua said: "Dazhuang, let's return the money to Kunzi. I gave those two pots of flowers to sister Xiaoya. What will happen now? Besides, those two pots of flowers are not worth so much money. Please call Kunzi quickly."
Zhang Dazhuang said with a smile: "Daughter-in-law, it's really unnecessary. You don't understand Kunzi. He treats me like a brother."
He Cuihua looked at Zhang Dazhuang, sighed and said, "Okay, I don't understand your men's world. As long as you treat me like a brother and sister, you'll be fine."
Zhang Dazhuang laughed and said: "Daughter-in-law, that is absolutely impossible!"
He Cuihua smiled and rolled her eyes at him.
At this time, a frivolous shout suddenly came from the door of the stall: "Hey, Zhang Heizi, I'm tired of being here with your wife in broad daylight. You have to be careful, there are so many eyes around you."
The speaker was a young man with yellow hair, wearing a black vest, with tattoos on his neck and arms, and several iron rings on his nose and ears. At first glance, he looked like a street gangster.
Behind Huang Mao were two young men dressed similarly to him. One had a shaved head and the other had long, flowing hair. The two of them were also carrying two baseball bats in their hands.
As soon as Zhang Dazhuang heard this voice, he couldn't help but feel sick in his heart, but he still had a respectful expression on his face and greeted Huang Mao: "Brother Fei, why did you use your free time to come here today? Please come in quickly."
Huang Mao said with a joking expression: "I miss your wife, so come over and have a look." As he said that, he winked at He Cuihua.
"You..." Zhang Dazhuang was about to get angry. His fists were already clenched, but He Cuihua stopped him.
Huang Mao started teasing even more unscrupulously, "Zhang Heizi, look at how cowardly you are, why do you still want to fight with me?"
Zhang Dazhuang gritted his teeth and said, "Brother Fei, don't go too far."
Huang Mao's eyebrows raised, the expression on his face changed as if from a different story, and he suddenly cursed: "You stinky shameless person"Damn it, who of us is too much? You owe me two months of protection money. If you don’t pay this damn thing now, I will destroy all your flowers and plants immediately!
Zhang Dazhuang was about to answer him angrily, but was pulled back by He Cuihua. He Cuihua stood in front and said with a smile: "Brother Fei, don't be angry. My Dazhuang has such a bad temper. It's not that we don't want to pay the protection fee. It's true that business has not been very good recently, and we have never been generous, and..."
He Cuihua paused, her tone became cautious, and said: "The protection fee has increased a bit too fast. It was only 200 yuan a month at first, but now it has increased to 800. We are a small business..."
Not letting He Cuihua finish her sentence, Huang Mao yelled angrily: "You bitch, don't talk about those useless things. What age are we in now? Prices are soaring. Why don't you allow me to increase the protection fee? Other families can pay the protection fee anyway, but your family doesn't. I think you are deliberately going against me and don't want to do anything here anymore!"
He Cuihua quickly said with a smile: "Brother Fei, don't get me wrong. I'm just a woman complaining. Don't take it seriously. We will definitely pay the protection fee, but do you think we can extend it for two more days?"
"No, I have to pay the protection fee now, or get out of here and stop hanging out in this farmer's market!" Huang Mao said domineeringly, and the two boys behind him shook the baseball bats in their hands.
There were a lot of people watching the excitement around. He Cuihua's cheeks were red and hot. Zhang Dazhuang stood behind He Cuihua and wanted to die. He was a dignified man, hiding behind a woman. What kind of thing was this? Thinking about it, he was ready to stand up and argue with Huang Mao. If it didn't work, he would fight him. He called this little brat brother all day long and was bullied by him. It was as disgusting as eating a fly!
He Cuihua seemed to have telepathy with him. As soon as he clenched his fists, he turned back to look at him and said in a low voice: "Don't be impulsive. I will handle this matter. After all, we have to live on this business."
As soon as he heard the word 'life', Zhang Dazhuang immediately lost his temper and had no choice but to suppress all his anger. In fact, his flower stall was not unprofitable, but he had a father who was sick and took medicine all year round, and a younger sister who had to support his education. The little money he earned from the flower stall in a month was not enough to open it.
He Cuihua called Fei Ge again with a smile and said a lot of good things. Huang Mao then reluctantly relented and said that he would give them another week. If they still couldn't pay the protection fee after one week, they would bear the consequences.
While talking, Huang Mao caught a glimpse of the 100 yuan left by Lin Kun in He Cuihua's hand. His eyes suddenly brightened and he grabbed it. He raised it and waved it proudly and said, "Let's go have a drink!" and led the two younger brothers away.
